{{redirect|Richard|Wallace's Sealeo named Richard|Wallace#Richard|Wallace}} [[File:Ricard Nouveau.png|thumb|250px|Ricard Nouveau]] '''Ricard Nouveau''' (Japanese: '''ピノ・ノワール''' ''Pinot Noir'') is an A-class [[Pokémon Connoisseur]] and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW080|Clash of the Connoisseurs!]]''. He was chosen along with {{an|Cilan}} by [[Mr. Hatterly]] to help choose a Pokémon for his daughter [[Marigold]]. Ricard believed that the perfect Pokémon for her would be {{p|Petilil}} because of its scent and cuteness. Cilan disagreed with him, thinking that a half {{type|Grass}} would be more suitable for her as opposed to a pure one. Since they couldn't agree, the two Connoisseurs decided to have a {{pkmn|battle}} to see who was right. Ricard ended up losing the battle. He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]''. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ricard Nouveau |pkmn=Purrloin |type1=Dark |img=Ricard Nouveau Purrloin.png |epnum=BW080 |epname=Clash of the Connoisseurs! |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Purrloin}} is Ricard's "Premium Brand" Pokémon. It battled {{an|Cilan}}'s {{TP|Cilan|Crustle}} to determine which Pokémon [[Marigold]] would use. In the beginning of the battle, it surprised Cilan with its speed, but still lost relatively quickly due to Crustle using a combination of {{m|Shell Smash}} and {{m|Rock Wrecker}}. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]''.
